name: A Solvent Spirit
summary: Master Vornal tests would-be pupils in Sen'jin Village as his eyesight fades. He asks them to gather makrura eyes and crawler mucus along Durotar's coast. Though he scoffs at taking an apprentice, the work tests patience and resolve.

sections.title: A Master's Fading Sight
sections.body: Master Vornal lives in Sen'jin Village, where age has dimmed his sight. Primal magic once came readily to his fingertips, but now he relies on alchemy to sharpen his perceptions and weave his arts. Though his body weakens, the stubborn troll refuses an apprentice. He says neither the Darkspear nor Durotar's orcs have produced anyone worthy of his teaching.

sections.title: Testing the Unproven
sections.body: Vornal asks for raw materials from the harsh coast: intact makrura eyes and vials of crawler mucus. Taking undamaged eyes from armored, snapping makrura calls for careful strikes. Gathering enough mucus tests whether a would-be pupil can endure tedious work. For Vornal, hunting these coastal beasts is less about the reagents than finding out who can keep their focus.

sections.title: A Measure of Will
sections.body: For Master Vornal, time and patience measure strength. He expects brash youths to grow frustrated or abandon the work. Bringing pristine ingredients back to Sen'jin Village shows survival skills along the dangerous reefs of the Echo Isles channel, and the discipline needed to master alchemy's subtle arts.

faq.answer: Master Vornal is an elderly troll alchemist and spellcaster who lives in Sen'jin Village. Age is failing his eyesight, so he uses alchemical solvents and brews to work magic that once came easily.

faq.q: Why does Vornal need makrura eyes and crawler mucus?
faq.answer: Vornal uses alchemical mixtures to aid his magic and compensate for his failing eyesight. He needs the mucus and intact makrura eyes as reagents, and gathering them tests would-be apprentices.

faq.q: Why is Vornal so reluctant to teach an apprentice?
aliases: is vornal looking for a student
faq.answer: Vornal expects great dedication and patience, and has little tolerance for arrogance. He believes no troll or orc has shown the devotion he requires, and sees most would-be pupils as proud and easily discouraged.

faq.q: Where are these creatures found around Sen'jin Village?
faq.answer: Crawlers and makrura roam the shallows along Darkspear Strand and the waterways between the mainland and the nearby Echo Isles.

faq.q: Why do the makrura eyes need to be intact?
faq.answer: Vornal needs undamaged sensory organs for brews that sharpen perception. A forceful strike can crush a makrura's delicate eyes, so the hunter must act with precision and restraint.

faq.q: What lesson is Vornal trying to teach?
faq.answer: Vornal believes patience tests character. The repetitive, dirty gathering along the surf lets him see whether a novice gives in to haste or keeps an alchemist's calm focus.

angles.text: For the Darkspear rebuilding at Sen'jin Village, proving yourself to elder practitioners like Master Vornal helps carry the tribe's mystical and alchemical traditions forward.
Vornal openly doubts that orcs have the quiet discipline alchemy demands. The work gives you a chance to show that Horde solidarity includes scholarly patience.
Coastal Durotar remains perilous for the fledgling Horde. Clearing aggressive makrura and surf crawlers helps secure the fishing shores around Sen'jin Village.
